zstddeclib.c is generated using the release's build/single_file_libs/combine.py:
  python combine.py -r ../../lib -x legacy/zstd_legacy.h -o zstddeclib.c zstddeclib-in.c
zstd.h and zstd_errors.h are unchanged release headers. No external DLL is needed.
